draft.subject: Following up on your bulk import and cancellation notes
draft.body:
Hi Kai,

Thanks for the notes. On bulk import: teammates can be bulk-invited from a CSV file instead of one at a time. Your cancellation request is open with our team, and for context, a cancellation takes effect at the end of the current billing cycle, not immediately -- a colleague will follow up on the details directly.

If it's useful before then, I'm happy to jump on a short call this week to set up one real project with you, since projects are the main organizing unit and tasks live inside them. Just reply with a time that suits.

Best,
Priya
